package postgres

import (
	"context"

	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/domain"
	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/domain/repository"
	"github.com/jackc/pgx/v5/pgxpool"
)

// TaskTestAnswerVariantRepoPG stores selected answer variants for test attempts.
type TaskTestAnswerVariantRepoPG struct {
	Pool *pgxpool.Pool
}

// ReplaceForAnswer replaces all selected variants for one attempt.
func (r TaskTestAnswerVariantRepoPG) ReplaceForAnswer(ctx context.Context, answerID string, variants []domain.TaskTestAnswerVariant) error {
	tx, err := r.Pool.Begin(ctx)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	defer func() { _ = tx.Rollback(ctx) }()

	if _, err := tx.Exec(ctx, `DELETE FROM task_test_answer_variant WHERE student_task_answer_id=$1`, answerID); err != nil {
		return err
	}

	for _, variant := range variants {
		if _, err := tx.Exec(ctx, `
INSERT INTO task_test_answer_variant (
    id,
    student_task_answer_id,
    task_id,
    task_test_id,
    task_test_variant_id,
    submitted_order,
    submitted_group_id,
    is_correct,
    created_at
)
VALUES ($1,$2,$3,$4,$5,$6,$7,$8,$9)
`, variant.ID, variant.StudentTaskAnswerID, variant.TaskID, variant.TaskTestID, variant.TaskTestVariantID, variant.SubmittedOrder, variant.SubmittedGroupID, variant.IsCorrect, variant.CreatedAt); err != nil {
			return err
		}
	}

	return tx.Commit(ctx)
}

// ListForAnswer returns submitted variants in deterministic question/order order.
func (r TaskTestAnswerVariantRepoPG) ListForAnswer(ctx context.Context, answerID string) ([]domain.TaskTestAnswerVariant, error) {
	rows, err := r.Pool.Query(ctx, `
SELECT
    id,
    student_task_answer_id,
    task_id,
    task_test_id,
    task_test_variant_id,
    submitted_order,
    submitted_group_id,
    is_correct,
    created_at
FROM task_test_answer_variant
WHERE student_task_answer_id=$1
ORDER BY task_test_id, submitted_order NULLS LAST, created_at, id
`, answerID)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	defer rows.Close()

	result := make([]domain.TaskTestAnswerVariant, 0)
	for rows.Next() {
		var item domain.TaskTestAnswerVariant
		if err := rows.Scan(
			&item.ID,
			&item.StudentTaskAnswerID,
			&item.TaskID,
			&item.TaskTestID,
			&item.TaskTestVariantID,
			&item.SubmittedOrder,
			&item.SubmittedGroupID,
			&item.IsCorrect,
			&item.CreatedAt,
		); err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		result = append(result, item)
	}
	if err := rows.Err(); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return result, nil
}

var _ repository.TaskTestAnswerVariantRepository = (*TaskTestAnswerVariantRepoPG)(nil)
var _ repository.TaskTestAnswerVariantReader = (*TaskTestAnswerVariantRepoPG)(nil)
